# Load packages

```{r load-packages}
library(DESeq2)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
# Register the legacy ExpData union only if dataset construction requires it.
# Pre-registering it can disrupt S4 initialization on newer Bioconductor stacks.
```

# Load count data and sample metadata

NAC11 is the historical construct label for NAC47. The publication count file
is an unchanged copy of the unfiltered NAC11-versus-empty matrix exported by
`MT_transient.rmd`, with four overexpression samples and four controls.
The copied metadata retains the original labels for traceability; NAC11 is
renamed to NAC47 in this analysis.

```{r load-data}
counts_raw <- read.delim(here("Data", "data_for_publication",
  "MtNAC47_vs_Empty_raw_counts.tsv"), check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
sample_metadata <- read.csv(here("Data", "data_for_publication",
  "MtNAC47_vs_Empty_metadata.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(c("RNAseqID", "Construct", "Replicate", "LeafNode") %in%
                names(sample_metadata)), "Geneid" %in% names(counts_raw),
          !anyDuplicated(sample_metadata$RNAseqID), !anyDuplicated(counts_raw$Geneid),
          setequal(sample_metadata$RNAseqID, names(counts_raw)[-1]),
          all(sample_metadata$Construct %in% c("MtNAC11", "Empty")),
          sum(sample_metadata$Construct == "MtNAC11") == 4,
          sum(sample_metadata$Construct == "Empty") == 4)
counts_mat <- as.matrix(counts_raw[, sample_metadata$RNAseqID, drop = FALSE])
stopifnot(is.numeric(counts_mat), all(is.finite(counts_mat)),
          all(counts_mat >= 0), all(counts_mat == round(counts_mat)))
storage.mode(counts_mat) <- "integer"
dimnames(counts_mat) <- list(unname(as.character(counts_raw$Geneid)),
                            unname(as.character(colnames(counts_mat))))
attr(counts_mat, "names") <- NULL
rownames(sample_metadata) <- unname(as.character(sample_metadata$RNAseqID))
sample_metadata$Construct[sample_metadata$Construct == "MtNAC11"] <- "MtNAC47"
stopifnot(identical(colnames(counts_mat), rownames(sample_metadata)))
print(table(sample_metadata$Construct))
```

# Differential-expression settings and annotation

DEGs require adjusted P value below 0.05, with no additional fold-change
threshold, matching the executable settings in `MT_transient.rmd`.
Positive log2 fold changes indicate higher expression under NAC47 overexpression.
Outputs are saved under `Data/data_for_publication/NAC47_overexpression`.

```{r differential-expression-settings}
alpha_cutoff <- 0.05
lfc_cutoff <- 0
pairwise_dir <- here("Data", "data_for_publication", "NAC47_overexpression")
dir.create(pairwise_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
annotation_summary <- read_tsv(here("MT_genome", "annotation",
  "MtrunA17r5.0-ANR-EGN-r1.9.summary.tsv"),
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), show_col_types = FALSE)
gene_annotation <- annotation_summary %>%
  transmute(Geneid = LOCUS_TAG, GeneName = case_when(
    !is.na(GN) & trimws(GN) != "" ~ GN,
    !is.na(PRODUCT) & trimws(PRODUCT) != "" ~ PRODUCT,
    TRUE ~ "")) %>% distinct(Geneid, .keep_all = TRUE)
pairwise_counts <- list(MtNAC47 = counts_mat)
pairwise_metadata <- list(MtNAC47 = sample_metadata)
```

# Prepare the NAC47 DESeq2 dataset

The NAC47 model contains eight samples and uses
`~ Replicate + LeafNode + Construct` to adjust for replicate and leaf node
before estimating the construct effect. Low-count genes are prefiltered
independently by requiring at least 10 counts in at least four of the eight
samples.

```{r prepare-nac47-dataset}
pairwise_result_dir <- file.path(pairwise_dir, "DESeq_results")
dir.create(pairwise_result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

pairwise_deseq_results <- list()
pairwise_summary <- list()

tf_name <- "MtNAC47"
  pair_counts <- pairwise_counts[[tf_name]]
  pair_metadata <- pairwise_metadata[[tf_name]]

  pair_keep <- unname(rowSums(pair_counts >= 10) >= 4)
  pair_counts_filtered <- pair_counts[pair_keep, , drop = FALSE]
  dimnames(pair_counts_filtered) <- list(
    unname(as.character(rownames(pair_counts_filtered))),
    unname(as.character(colnames(pair_counts_filtered))))
  attr(pair_counts_filtered, "names") <- NULL
  pair_metadata <- as.data.frame(pair_metadata)
  rownames(pair_metadata) <- unname(colnames(pair_counts_filtered))

  pair_metadata$Construct <- relevel(
    factor(pair_metadata$Construct),
    ref = "Empty"
  )
  pair_metadata$Replicate <- factor(pair_metadata$Replicate)
  pair_metadata$LeafNode <- factor(pair_metadata$LeafNode)

  model_matrix <- model.matrix(~ Replicate + LeafNode + Construct, pair_metadata)
  stopifnot(qr(model_matrix)$rank == ncol(model_matrix),
            nrow(model_matrix) > ncol(model_matrix), nrow(pair_counts_filtered) > 0)

  make_pair_dds <- function() {
    DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
      countData = pair_counts_filtered,
      colData = pair_metadata,
      design = ~ Replicate + LeafNode + Construct
    )
  }
  pair_dds <- tryCatch(make_pair_dds(), error = function(e) {
    if (grepl("ExpData", conditionMessage(e), fixed = TRUE) &&
        !methods::isClass("ExpData")) {
      methods::setClassUnion("ExpData", c("matrix", "SummarizedExperiment"))
      make_pair_dds()
    } else {
      stop(e)
    }
  })
```

# PCA of NAC47 overexpression and empty-vector samples

A blind variance-stabilizing transformation shows the variation among the eight
samples before testing the NAC47 construct effect. Points are colored by replicate
and shaped by construct.

```{r nac47-pca, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
  vsd_qc <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(pair_dds, blind = TRUE)
  pca_data <- plotPCA(vsd_qc, intgroup = c("Construct", "Replicate", "LeafNode"),
                      returnData = TRUE)
  percent_variance <- round(100 * attr(pca_data, "percentVar"))
  pca_plot <- ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1, PC2, color = Replicate, shape = Construct)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = name), vjust = -0.8, size = 3, check_overlap = TRUE) +
    labs(title = "NAC47 versus Empty: PCA",
         x = paste0("PC1: ", percent_variance[1], "% variance"),
         y = paste0("PC2: ", percent_variance[2], "% variance")) + theme_bw()
  print(pca_plot)
  ggsave(file.path(pairwise_result_dir, "MtNAC47_vs_Empty_PCA.pdf"),
         pca_plot, width = 8, height = 6)
```

# Identify NAC47 overexpression DEGs

After examining sample variation in the PCA, fit the model to estimate the NAC47
versus empty-vector effect while adjusting for replicate and leaf node. Significant
genes are separated by the direction of their log2 fold change and summarized in
the volcano plot below.

```{r nac47-deseq2}
  pair_dds <- DESeq(pair_dds)
  write_csv(as.data.frame(counts(pair_dds, normalized = TRUE)) %>%
              rownames_to_column("Geneid"),
            file.path(pairwise_result_dir, "MtNAC47_vs_Empty_normalized_counts.csv"))

  pair_result <- results(
    pair_dds,
    contrast = c("Construct", tf_name, "Empty"),
    alpha = alpha_cutoff
  )

  pair_result_table <- as.data.frame(pair_result) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Geneid") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(gene_annotation, by = "Geneid") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(GeneName = dplyr::coalesce(GeneName, "")) %>%
    dplyr::relocate(GeneName, .after = Geneid) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(padj)

  pair_deg_table <- pair_result_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(padj),
      padj < alpha_cutoff,
      abs(log2FoldChange) >= lfc_cutoff
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Regulation = dplyr::case_when(
        log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "Upregulated",
        log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "Downregulated",
        TRUE ~ "Unchanged"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Geneid, GeneName, Regulation, log2FoldChange, padj
    )

  pair_upregulated <- pair_deg_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(Regulation == "Upregulated")
  pair_downregulated <- pair_deg_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(Regulation == "Downregulated")

  write_csv(
    pair_result_table,
    file.path(
      pairwise_result_dir,
      paste0(tf_name, "_vs_Empty_all_results.csv")
    )
  )
  write_csv(
    pair_deg_table,
    file.path(
      pairwise_result_dir,
      paste0(tf_name, "_vs_Empty_DEGs.csv")
    )
  )
  write_csv(
    pair_upregulated,
    file.path(
      pairwise_result_dir,
      paste0(tf_name, "_vs_Empty_upregulated_DEGs.csv")
    )
  )
  write_csv(
    pair_downregulated,
    file.path(
      pairwise_result_dir,
      paste0(tf_name, "_vs_Empty_downregulated_DEGs.csv")
    )
  )
  saveRDS(
    pair_dds,
    file.path(pairwise_result_dir, paste0(tf_name, "_vs_Empty_dds.rds"))
  )

  pairwise_deseq_results[[tf_name]] <- list(
    dds = pair_dds,
    all = pair_result_table,
    deg = pair_deg_table,
    upregulated = pair_upregulated,
    downregulated = pair_downregulated
  )
  pairwise_summary[[tf_name]] <- data.frame(
    TF = tf_name,
    Samples = ncol(pair_dds),
    Genes_tested = nrow(pair_dds),
    DEGs = nrow(pair_deg_table),
    Upregulated = nrow(pair_upregulated),
    Downregulated = nrow(pair_downregulated)
  )

  cat(
    tf_name, "vs Empty: ", nrow(pair_deg_table), " DEGs (",
    nrow(pair_upregulated), " upregulated; ",
    nrow(pair_downregulated), " downregulated)\n",
    sep = ""
  )

pairwise_summary_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(pairwise_summary)
write_csv(
  pairwise_summary_table,
  file.path(pairwise_result_dir, "pairwise_DESeq_summary.csv")
)

all_pairwise_classified_degs <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
  names(pairwise_deseq_results),
  function(tf_name) {
    pairwise_deseq_results[[tf_name]]$deg %>%
      dplyr::mutate(TF = tf_name, .before = 1)
  }
))
write_csv(
  all_pairwise_classified_degs,
  file.path(pairwise_result_dir, "all_pairwise_classified_DEGs.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  pairwise_deseq_results,
  file.path(pairwise_result_dir, "all_pairwise_DESeq_results.rds")
)

pairwise_summary_table
```

```{r mtnac47-figure-setup, include=FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE) ||
    !requireNamespace("stringr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("ggrepel and stringr are required for the appended NAC47 figures.")
}
table_dir <- file.path(pairwise_dir, "tables")
figure_dir <- file.path(pairwise_dir, "figures")
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
normalize_gene_id <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  sub("^MtrunA17(?=(Chr|CP|MT))", "MtrunA17_", x, perl = TRUE)
}
```

```{r load-mtnac47-transient-degs, include=FALSE}
mtnac47_deg_file <- file.path(pairwise_result_dir, "MtNAC47_vs_Empty_DEGs.csv")
mtnac47_all_results_file <- file.path(pairwise_result_dir, "MtNAC47_vs_Empty_all_results.csv")

missing_mtnac47_transient_files <- c(
  mtnac47_deg_file,
  mtnac47_all_results_file
)
missing_mtnac47_transient_files <-
  missing_mtnac47_transient_files[
    !file.exists(missing_mtnac47_transient_files)
  ]
if (length(missing_mtnac47_transient_files) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing MtNAC47 transient file(s): ",
    paste(missing_mtnac47_transient_files, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

mtnac47_degs <- read_csv(
  mtnac47_deg_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

required_mtnac47_deg_columns <- c(
  "Geneid",
  "GeneName",
  "Regulation",
  "log2FoldChange",
  "padj"
)
missing_mtnac47_deg_columns <- setdiff(
  required_mtnac47_deg_columns,
  names(mtnac47_degs)
)
if (length(missing_mtnac47_deg_columns) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing required MtNAC47 DEG column(s): ",
    paste(missing_mtnac47_deg_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

mtnac47_degs <- mtnac47_degs %>%
  transmute(
    TF = "MtNAC47",
    geneId = normalize_gene_id(Geneid),
    GeneName = as.character(GeneName),
    Regulation = as.character(Regulation),
    log2FoldChange = as.numeric(log2FoldChange),
    padj = as.numeric(padj)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(geneId),
    geneId != "",
    Regulation %in% c("Upregulated", "Downregulated")
  ) %>%
  distinct(geneId, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(Regulation, padj)

mtnac47_upregulated_genes <- mtnac47_degs %>%
  filter(Regulation == "Upregulated")

mtnac47_all_results <- read_csv(
  mtnac47_all_results_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
if (!"Geneid" %in% names(mtnac47_all_results)) {
  stop(
    "Geneid is missing from the complete MtNAC47 result file: ",
    mtnac47_all_results_file
  )
}

mtnac47_tested_genes <- mtnac47_all_results %>%
  transmute(geneId = normalize_gene_id(Geneid)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(geneId), geneId != "") %>%
  distinct(geneId) %>%
  pull(geneId)

write_csv(
  mtnac47_degs,
  file.path(
    table_dir,
    "MtNAC47_transient_DEGs.csv"
  )
)
write_csv(
  mtnac47_upregulated_genes,
  file.path(
    table_dir,
    "MtNAC47_transient_upregulated_genes.csv"
  )
)
```

# Volcano plot of NAC47 overexpression DEGs

Significant genes use the same rule as the DEG table: adjusted p < 0.05.
Upregulated genes have a positive log2 fold change and downregulated genes
have a negative log2 fold change. Labels mark the flavonoid, cell-wall,
jasmonate, and defense genes selected from the log2 fold change > 4 set.

```{r mtnac47-transient-deg-direction-figure}
mtnac47_volcano_data <- mtnac47_all_results %>%
  transmute(
    geneId = normalize_gene_id(Geneid),
    GeneName = as.character(GeneName),
    log2FoldChange = as.numeric(log2FoldChange),
    padj = as.numeric(padj)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(geneId),
    geneId != "",
    !is.na(log2FoldChange),
    is.finite(log2FoldChange)
  ) %>%
  distinct(geneId, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10_padj = -log10(pmax(padj, .Machine$double.xmin)),
    plot_neg_log10_padj = pmin(neg_log10_padj, 20),
    Regulation = case_when(
      !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "Upregulated",
      !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "Downregulated",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    ),
    Regulation = factor(
      Regulation,
      levels = c("Not significant", "Downregulated", "Upregulated")
    ),
    volcano_label = dplyr::recode(
      geneId,
      "MtrunA17_Chr4g0006371" = "anthocyanidin synthase",
      "MtrunA17_Chr7g0242551" = "flavonol synthase",
      "MtrunA17_Chr4g0008521" = "laccase",
      "MtrunA17_Chr5g0399861" = "MtJAZ1",
      "MtrunA17_Chr5g0399881" = "MtJAZ2",
      "MtrunA17_Chr8g0342991" = "lipoxygenase",
      "MtrunA17_Chr3g0119681" = "MtCYP94B55",
      "MtrunA17_Chr6g0476831" = "MtKunitz40",
      "MtrunA17_Chr6g0476961" = "MtKunitz36",
      "MtrunA17_Chr2g0317751" = "MtDEF1",
      .default = NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Regulation)

write_csv(
  mtnac47_volcano_data,
  file.path(table_dir, "MtNAC47_transient_DEG_volcano.csv")
)

mtnac47_deg_direction_plot <- ggplot(
  mtnac47_volcano_data,
  aes(
    x = log2FoldChange,
    y = plot_neg_log10_padj,
    color = Regulation
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    data = dplyr::filter(mtnac47_volcano_data, is.na(volcano_label)),
    size = 1.1,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = dplyr::filter(mtnac47_volcano_data, !is.na(volcano_label)),
    aes(fill = Regulation),
    shape = 21,
    size = 2,
    stroke = 0.8,
    color = "black",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.05),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.35,
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linewidth = 0.35,
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = dplyr::filter(mtnac47_volcano_data, !is.na(volcano_label)),
    aes(label = volcano_label),
    color = "black",
    size = 2.5,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    box.padding = 0.2,
    point.padding = 0.15,
    segment.size = 0.25,
    segment.color = "grey40",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Upregulated" = "#D73027",
      "Downregulated" = "#4575B4",
      "Not significant" = "grey75"
    ),
    breaks = c("Upregulated", "Downregulated", "Not significant")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Upregulated" = "#D73027",
      "Downregulated" = "#4575B4",
      "Not significant" = "grey75"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "MtNAC47 transient-expression DEGs",
    subtitle = "MtNAC11 construct versus Empty vector",
    x = "log2 fold change",
    y = expression(-log[10]~adjusted~italic(P)),
    color = NULL,
    caption = "Genes with -log10 adjusted P above 20 are shown at 20."
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 22)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "MtNAC47_transient_DEG_volcano.png"),
  mtnac47_deg_direction_plot,
  width = 9,
  height = 7.5,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "MtNAC47_transient_DEG_volcano.pdf"),
  mtnac47_deg_direction_plot,
  width = 9,
  height = 7.5,
  bg = "white"
)
```

# GO enrichment of MtNAC47 upregulated genes

The query is the upregulated MtNAC11-versus-Empty genes. The background is
every gene tested in that comparison. Enrichment uses topGO's classic Fisher
test. Benjamini–Hochberg correction is applied across every tested Biological
Process term, and terms with adjusted p < 0.05 are called significant.

```{r go-enrichment-mtnac47-upregulated-classic}
if (!requireNamespace("topGO", quietly = TRUE) ||
    !requireNamespace("GO.db", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop(
    "topGO and GO.db are required. Install them with: ",
    "BiocManager::install(c('topGO', 'GO.db'))"
  )
}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(topGO)
  library(GO.db)
})

# Reload the prepared GO mapping when this chunk is run independently.
go_sets_file <- here(
  "MT_genome", "annotation", "GO_gene_sets_MtrunA17r5.rds"
)
go_pairs_file <- here(
  "MT_genome", "annotation", "GO_gene_pairs_MtrunA17r5.tsv"
)
GO2genes_pairwise <- if (file.exists(go_sets_file)) {
  readRDS(go_sets_file)
} else {
  NULL
}

valid_pairwise_go_sets <- is.list(GO2genes_pairwise) &&
  !is.null(names(GO2genes_pairwise)) &&
  length(GO2genes_pairwise) > 0 &&
  mean(grepl("^GO:", names(GO2genes_pairwise))) > 0.9

if (!valid_pairwise_go_sets) {
  pairwise_go_pairs <- read_tsv(
    go_pairs_file,
    col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(gene = LOCUS_TAG, go = GO) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(gene), gene != "",
      !is.na(go), go != ""
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(gene, go)
  GO2genes_pairwise <- split(
    pairwise_go_pairs$gene,
    pairwise_go_pairs$go
  )
}

mtnac47_go_background <- unique(mtnac47_tested_genes)
mtnac47_up_query <- intersect(
  mtnac47_upregulated_genes$geneId,
  mtnac47_go_background
)
if (length(mtnac47_up_query) < 5L) {
  stop(
    "Fewer than 5 upregulated MtNAC47 genes are in the tested-gene background."
  )
}

mtnac47_up_gene_list <- factor(
  as.integer(mtnac47_go_background %in% mtnac47_up_query),
  levels = c(0, 1)
)
names(mtnac47_up_gene_list) <- mtnac47_go_background

mtnac47_up_go_data <- methods::new(
  "topGOdata",
  ontology = "BP",
  allGenes = mtnac47_up_gene_list,
  geneSel = function(x) x == "1",
  annot = topGO::annFUN.GO2genes,
  GO2genes = GO2genes_pairwise,
  nodeSize = 5
)
mtnac47_up_fisher <- topGO::runTest(
  mtnac47_up_go_data,
  algorithm = "classic",
  statistic = "fisher"
)

mtnac47_up_go_results <- topGO::GenTable(
  mtnac47_up_go_data,
  Fisher = mtnac47_up_fisher,
  orderBy = "Fisher",
  ranksOf = "Fisher",
  topNodes = length(topGO::score(mtnac47_up_fisher)),
  numChar = 200
) %>%
  mutate(
    TF = "MtNAC47",
    upregulated_gene_count = length(mtnac47_up_query),
    background_gene_count = length(mtnac47_go_background),
    Fisher_pvalue = unname(topGO::score(mtnac47_up_fisher)[GO.ID]),
    padj = p.adjust(Fisher_pvalue, method = "BH"),
    Significant_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Significant)),
    Expected_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Expected)),
    FoldEnrichment = if_else(
      is.finite(Expected_num) & Expected_num > 0,
      Significant_num / Expected_num,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  relocate(
    TF,
    upregulated_gene_count,
    background_gene_count
  ) %>%
  arrange(padj, Fisher_pvalue)

mtnac47_up_go_significant <- mtnac47_up_go_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05)

mtnac47_up_go_csv <- file.path(
  table_dir,
  "MtNAC47_transient_upregulated_classic_topGO_BP.csv"
)
mtnac47_up_go_sig_csv <- file.path(
  table_dir,
  "MtNAC47_transient_upregulated_classic_topGO_BP_significant.csv"
)
write_csv(mtnac47_up_go_results, mtnac47_up_go_csv)
write_csv(mtnac47_up_go_significant, mtnac47_up_go_sig_csv)

cat(
  "MtNAC47 upregulated classic GO:\n",
  "  Query genes: ", length(mtnac47_up_query), "\n",
  "  Background genes: ", length(mtnac47_go_background), "\n",
  "  Tested BP terms: ", nrow(mtnac47_up_go_results), "\n",
  "  Significant terms: ", nrow(mtnac47_up_go_significant),
  " -> ", mtnac47_up_go_sig_csv, "\n",
  sep = ""
)

knitr::kable(
  mtnac47_up_go_significant,
  caption = "Significant classic BP terms for MtNAC47 upregulated genes"
)
```

# MtNAC47 upregulated GO terms by class

The plot shows selected significant terms grouped by biological class. Parent terms
that repeat the same genes are omitted, including the broader jasmonate
response terms, defense response, and the branched-chain amino acid child
term. Jasmonate signaling and oxylipin biosynthesis stay as separate hormone
terms, and the protease term is shown as peptide regulation.

```{r plot-existing-mtnac47-upregulated-go, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=2.8}
existing_mtnac47_up_go_file <- file.path(
  table_dir,
  "MtNAC47_transient_upregulated_classic_topGO_BP_significant.csv"
)
if (!file.exists(existing_mtnac47_up_go_file)) {
  stop(
    "MtNAC47 classic upregulated GO file is missing: ",
    existing_mtnac47_up_go_file
  )
}

mtnac47_go_class_levels <- c(
  "Peptide regulation",
  "Hormone signaling",
  "Defense and stress",
  "Lipid metabolism",
  "Amino acid metabolism",
  "ROS metabolism"
)
mtnac47_go_highlights <- c(
  "GO:0010466" = "Peptide regulation",
  "GO:2000022" = "Hormone signaling",
  "GO:0031408" = "Hormone signaling",
  "GO:0009611" = "Defense and stress",
  "GO:0034440" = "Lipid metabolism",
  "GO:0006633" = "Lipid metabolism",
  "GO:0009063" = "Amino acid metabolism",
  "GO:0042744" = "ROS metabolism"
)

existing_mtnac47_up_go_plot_data <- read_csv(
  existing_mtnac47_up_go_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(GO.ID %in% names(mtnac47_go_highlights)) %>%
  mutate(
    padj = as.numeric(padj),
    Significant_num = as.numeric(Significant_num),
    FoldEnrichment = as.numeric(FoldEnrichment),
    neg_log10_padj = -log10(padj),
    GO_class = unname(mtnac47_go_highlights[GO.ID]),
    GO_class = factor(GO_class, levels = mtnac47_go_class_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(GO_class, padj, desc(FoldEnrichment)) %>%
  mutate(
    TermLabel = stringr::str_wrap(Term, width = 38),
    TermLabel = factor(TermLabel, levels = rev(TermLabel))
  )

write_csv(
  existing_mtnac47_up_go_plot_data %>%
    mutate(TermLabel = as.character(TermLabel)),
  file.path(
    table_dir,
    "MtNAC47_transient_upregulated_classic_topGO_BP_classified.csv"
  )
)

existing_mtnac47_up_go_plot <- ggplot(
  existing_mtnac47_up_go_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = FoldEnrichment,
    y = TermLabel,
    size = Significant_num,
    color = neg_log10_padj
  )
) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 0, xend = FoldEnrichment, y = TermLabel, yend = TermLabel),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "#D9D9D9",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.95) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    option = "viridis",
    direction = -1,
    name = expression(-log[10](italic(p)[adj]))
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(2.6, 6.5),
    name = "Upregulated genes"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.06))
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    expand = expansion(add = 0.22)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  guides(
    color = guide_colorbar(
      barwidth = grid::unit(0.28, "cm"),
      barheight = grid::unit(1.8, "cm")
    ),
    size = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(color = "grey35"),
      order = 2
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Fold enrichment",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, lineheight = 0.9),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.32, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.spacing.y = grid::unit(0.08, "cm"),
    legend.box.spacing = grid::unit(0.12, "cm"),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    plot.margin = margin(6, 6, 2, 2)
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_dir,
    "MtNAC47_transient_upregulated_classic_GO_by_class.png"
  ),
  existing_mtnac47_up_go_plot,
  width = 7.2,
  height = 2.8,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
ggsave(
  file.path(
    figure_dir,
    "MtNAC47_transient_upregulated_classic_GO_by_class.pdf"
  ),
  existing_mtnac47_up_go_plot,
  width = 7.2,
  height = 2.8,
  bg = "white"
)
```
